text:
Situation: Cytarabine has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-09-24, a period of 61 months as of 2026-10-21. Current on-hand supply across Corvale sites ranges from 8.7 to 27 days at present usage rates.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 1110628 of Gland Pharma Limited ended on 2019-11-01 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2019-12-10. That inspection occurred 693 days before FDA posted the cytarabine shortage on 2021-09-24. FDA's records do not state that this inspection caused or explains the shortage.

Our position: Supply is critically low at multiple sites. The rule-based best option is Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and uses Kindos Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. (last inspection VAI 2024-07-19). An approved alternate manufacturer is Gland Pharma Limited (NDC 68083034305), approved for P&T interchange on 2026-01-15.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. as primary source; requires buyer approval.
2. Pharmacist to activate Gland Pharma Limited NDC 68083034305 as approved alternate; requires pharmacist approval per 2026-01-15 P&T interchange.
3. Buyer to qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC and Jazz Pharmaceuticals, Inc. as backup sources; requires buyer approval for each.
4. Pharmacist to prepare Hospira, Inc. 20 mg/mL concentration change protocol; requires pharmacist approval per 2025-10-06 P&T approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending further FDA updates given 61-month shortage duration and single-digit day supply at Corvale East.
